subject: Data Engineering
title: The Hadoop Ecosystem
description: A 60-second lesson on The Hadoop Ecosystem.

hook.text: Hadoop alone was painful. So the community built dozens of tools to fill the gaps.

buildup.text: Hive added SQL. Pig added scripting. HBase added real-time lookups. Sqoop moved data in and out.

discovery.text: ZooKeeper handled coordination. Oozie handled workflow orchestration. Each tool solved one problem.

twist.text: The ecosystem grew so complex that managing it became a job in itself — the 'Hadoop admin.'

climax.text: Cloudera and Hortonworks packaged the ecosystem into distributions, selling simplicity to enterprises.

punchline.text: One elephant spawned an entire zoo of tools.

quiz.question: What did Apache Hive add to the Hadoop ecosystem?
options: SQL query capability on top of Hadoop data
